messages.author: 36a7cb8f6d90c718
messages.subject: Deducer: Changing Axis Labels
parts:
I have a simple scatter plot showing the relationship of fruit set of a study species and co-flowering density in the study area. I have the graph looking pretty much the way I want it, but for the life of me cannot figure out how to change the x and y axis labels. Right now they are the names of the columns in my data set. Although I could change the names in the data set, I know there has to be a much simpler (and most likely obvious) way to change the labels right in Deducer's plot builder. 

Can someone help me with this?

Thank you

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Deducer: Changing Axis Labels
parts:
If you have the most recent version of Deducer. go to the Other tab.
There are items "xlab" and "ylab" which are what you want.

ian

messages.subject: Re: Deducer: Changing Axis Labels
parts:
1. You can upgrade your R to the latest version, and then install from CRAN.
2. You can try install.packages("Deducer",type="source") which may or
may not work depending on your system set-up.

ian
